messages:
rachel_fin: FYI getting a customer ping from Apex Therapeuticsabout their renewal invoice showing a "platform fee - onboarding" plus full annual platform fee. they said onboarding was waived. invoice INV-2027-0310-455 attached.

mike_billing: pulling invoice and contract. which contract id?

lucas_csm: APEX-2023-078, onboarding credited in email thread (sales rep waived onboarding fee on 2027-02-20). onboarding note: waived but billing still added a $5,000 line on 2027-03-10.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2027-0310-455 generated for APEX-2023-078
 $125,000. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/INV-2027-0310-455.pdf

priya_sales: we have an email from me to customer on 2027-02-20 "Onboarding fee waived per promo code APEX-WAIVE-02" and internal note on the account. looks like a mapping mismatch between sales note and Zuora rate plan.

ermm mike_billing: (typo) ok. ledger shows Onboarding Fee $5k posted; annual platform fee $15k posted as expected. the onboarding waiver existed as a free-of-charge field in the CRM but never flowed to billing.

eric_fpna: what's the customer ask? do they want credit or invoice reissue?

lucas_csm: they want a visible credit before their accounts-payable run next week.

sophie_finance: threshold check: $5k credit is within auto-approve. finance supports issuing a credit memo and adding a root cause note. also please add a short customer-facing explanation on the portal.

mike_billing: will create CreditMemo-CM-2027-0311-210 for $5,000 and apply to INV-2027-0310-455. adding note: "Onboarding fee waived per sales agreement 2027-02-20; posting credit."

billing-bot: Draft Credit Memo CM-2027-0311-210 created for APEX-2023-078
 $5,000. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0311-210-draft.pdf

priya_sales: i'll forward the sales email to billing so it's attached to the credit memo.

mike_billing: credit posted and applied. PDF: https://invoices.internal/redwood/CM-2027-0311-210.pdf. Account note updated. net invoice now $120,000.

eric_fpna: please label journal entry JNL-2027-03-REV-WAIVE and include memo "onboarding fee waiver - Apex" for month close.

sophie_finance: one process ask: can we add a quick pre-renewal sync that joins sales notes and billing rate plans to prevent CRM-only waivers from missing? cc @priya_sales.

priya_sales: agreed. i'll open a small ops ticket to include waiver flags in Zuora mapping and add a checklist item for renewals.

rachel_fin: thanks team
 closing loop with customer now."
